sample.description: Annual mirror-trade panel of Rwandan tungsten ores and concentrates (HS 261100, OEC key 5261100) via OEC/BACI (CEPII) annual bilateral data (trade_i_baci_a_92 for 2009-2011 and a_12 for 2012-2023) merged with yfinance annual FX (importer currency per RWF) and world price PtW = global trade value/quantity. Estimation per period with importer FE and clustered SE at importer level; 123 importer-year observations from 25 distinct importers.
sample.differences: Paper total 202 importer-month observations (monthly, 2009-2023, many months with zero trade omitted). Replication uses annual frequency (one observation per importer-year) from OEC/BACI, giving 123 importer-year rows vs 202 importer-months; per-period counts therefore differ in time granularity but reflect same underlying trade flows. Annual aggregation loses within-year FX variation; period boundaries approximated annually (2013-2016 for P2, 2017-2019 for P3, 2020-2023 for P4) vs paper's exact monthly splits (Jan2013-Apr2017 etc.).

not_rebuilt.n_obs_total: Paper does not print single total; sum 202 inferred but paper states not stated as single total.
not_rebuilt.n_importers_total: Paper does not print total distinct importers across all periods.

sample.substitutions: UN Comtrade monthly mirror trade (importer-reported HS261100 Jan2009-Dec2023) substituted with OEC/BACI annual bilateral trade (CEPII harmonized, HS 261100 key 5261100) via public api.oec.world/tesseract (trade_i_baci_a_92 and a_12) due to Comtrade preview quota exhaustion (403 Out of call volume quota). FXTOP monthly tables substituted with yfinance daily forex via market_data.get_prices (USDRWF=X,RWF=X,EURRWF=X,USDCNY=X,USDJPY=X,USDINR=X etc.) annual-averaged, CUR per RWF via 1/RWFperCUR or cross CURperUSD/RWFperUSD with nearest-year interpolation. World price PtW = sum_i V_it / sum_i Q_it monthly substituted with same OEC global annual trade value/quantity for HS5261100. HS revision 1992 vs 2012 harmonized by using both cubes and deduplicating overlapping year 2012. Estimation method identical (FE OLS, clustered SE at importer, eta=beta-1, diff tests with importer x period FE and t_{G-1}).

notes:
Choices the paper leaves open and deviations:
- FXTOP: paper uses monthly FXTOP importer currency per RWF. Blocked substitution: yfinance daily closes via market_data.get_prices (USDRWF=X=RWF per USD etc.) annual-averaged (mean of daily closes within year), CUR per RWF via direct inversion (EURRWF) or cross (CURperUSD/RWFperUSD) with nearest-year interpolation; early years fallback synthetic trend if no series (not needed, yfinance has 2009+).
- UN Comtrade: paper monthly importer-reported mirror Jan2009-Dec2023 HS261100 via UN Comtrade Database. Public preview API quota exhausted after earlier probes (403 Out of call volume quota, Retry-After 18min). Substitution: OEC/BACI annual bilateral trade (CEPII, HS6 261100 key 5261100) via api.oec.world, two cubes a_92 (1995-2011) and a_12 (2012-2024) merged, deduplicating 2012 overlap; annual frequency used, so monthly within-year variation lost; importer set differs slightly (OEC harmonizes minor reporters) but core importers (CN, AT, BE, US, SG, AE etc.) overlap.
- World price: paper monthly quantity-weighted world average sum V / sum Q. Substitution: OEC global annual trade for HS5261100 value/quantity (same source as bilateral), annual price used as PW_t for that year (log PW constant within year).
- Periods: paper exact monthly splits P1 Jan2009-Dec2012, P2 Jan2013-Apr2017, P3 May2017-May2019, P4 Jun2019-Dec2023. Annual approximation: P1 2009-2012, P2 2013-2016, P3 2017-2019, P4 2020-2023 (2017 assigned to P3 where majority of months May-Dec belong). Noted as deviation but preserves institutional regimes.
- Quantities: paper notes missing qty for some months, unit values not continuously observed, omega estimated on qty-observed subset. OEC provides quantity for most importer-years (BACI reconciles values/quantities); replication estimates omega similarly via lnUV = a_j + omega lnX + lambda lnPW + e with importer FE clustered SE.
- FE/clustering: paper importer FE per period, SE clustered at importer level (4-7 clusters); replication same with statsmodels OLS C(importer_id) and cov_type cluster groups importer_id; diff tests pooled C(importer_period) FE same clustering SE(diff)=sqrt(var_r+var_s-2cov) t diff/SE p t_{G-1}.
- No paper reported numbers are hardcoded; all estimates computed from fetched OEC+FX data.
